question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

An area/place in which dead bodies are buried
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cemetery"** means a large burial ground, especially one not in a churchyard. (कब्रिस्तान)

 
 
• **Example:** The **cemetery** was located on the outskirts of the town, surrounded by tall trees.
 
 
 
• The correct word **"an area/place in which dead bodies are buried"** can be substituted with the word **"cemetery" **in the context of the sentence.
 
 
• **Example:** They visited the** cemetery** to pay respects to their ancestors.
 
 

Therefore, the correct one word substitution for the given phrase is **Cemetery**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Demise** (मृत्यु): A person's death.

 
 
• **Example:** His sudden **demise** shocked everyone in the community.
 
 
 
• **Mansion** (महल): A large, impressive house.
 
 
• **Example:** The wealthy businessman lived in a grand** mansion** overlooking the city.
 
 
 
• **Clementi** (क्लेमेंटी (एक नाम)): This refers to a name and not a relevant word in this context.
 
 
• **Example:** **Clementi **is a popular suburb in Singapore.
